sites.name: Philpot Picnic Area
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.hours: Day use only; no overnight camping allowed
sites.about: This facility has 6 picnic spots and vault toilets. There is no water system and the access to the facility is unpaved. The facility provides hiking access for the Philpot Interpretive Trail.
sites.directions: Follow CA SR 3 South of Hayfork and turn West on Rattlesnake Rd. Turn right on Forest Road 30N31, Picnic Area will be on the left.

sites.name: Indian Valley Camp
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.about: This minimally developed campsite has vault toilets but no other features.
sites.directions: From Hayfork take County Road 317 and turn west on County Road 10 and follow it to the campsite.
